subject: Clarify announcement visibility & logo exception on Order Form
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearview.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify announcement visibility & logo exception on Order Form

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. We circulated the draft Order Form (attached) and your team’s proposed redlines. Two quick asks we want to confirm so we can move the contract to signature:

1) Public announcement & reference rights: your legal team has flagged a clause that would restrict Redwood from publicly naming Clearview as a customer for 12 months post-signature. For Go-to-market planning (joint announcement + customer quote), our standard approach is a short embargo window (max 30 days) and a one-line permission to use the Clearview name/logo on our customer page and in press materials. Would Clearview consider a 30-day embargo and a quote approval step?

2) Logo usage and brand review: you requested that all logo assets be pre-approved each time they’re used. We can agree to brand review for press releases and co-branded assets, but we’d like to keep a standing permission for inclusion on our customer list / case study page (with the right to remove at your request).

I’ve attached a marked-up Order Form and a short proposed compromise in the doc titled Proposed_Redlines_Clearview.docx — Marissa from Legal added suggested language for a mutually acceptable publicity carve-out. Can you loop in Sally from your comms/legal and let us know if the 30-day embargo + approval for quotes/press releases is workable?

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_OrderForm_v3.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: Proposed_Redlines_Clearview.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)], [Attachment: Logo_Guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)]

Next steps: if we get thumbs up on visibility scope, Ben and I can issue a final order form for signature today.

Best,
Jordan

Company: Redwood Inference
From: Clearview Legal <legal@clearview.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearview.ai>
Cc: Sally Tran <s.tran@clearview.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify announcement visibility & logo exception on Order Form

Jordan / Maria —

Thanks for the note and the redlines. We appreciate the flexibility but need to flag two concerns from a legal/comms perspective:

• The proposed 30-day embargo is acceptable in principle, however Clearview requires an explicit approval workflow for any quote used in public materials (i.e., we need a defined approver and 5 business day review turnaround).

• On logo usage: pre-approval for every usage is heavy for our comms team. We could accept a standing permission limited to product/customer lists (e.g., vendor pages and case study directories) provided Redwood agrees to: (a) not modify the logo assets, (b) stop use within 48 hours of a takedown request, and (c) provide a one-time draft of the co-branded release for review prior to publish.

Attached are our marked-up redlines (see Proposed_Redlines_Clearview.docx). We’ve also proposed that publicity language remain subject to mutual written consent to avoid unilateral announcements.

From a timeline perspective, legal would like to see a final Order Form signed before we approve a public announcement; we can move quickly if the approval workflow and takedown commitments are explicit.

Regards,
Clearview Legal
legal@clearview.ai

[Attachment: Proposed_Redlines_Clearview.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Subject: Re: Clarify announcement visibility & logo exception on Order Form

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for outlining Clearview’s position. I did a pass on the language and attempted to capture the operational commitments you requested while protecting both parties. Summary of the proposed compromise (see attached doc for full redline):

• Embargo window: 30 days from execution. During that time, neither party will publicly announce the commercial relationship except for confidential internal communications.
• Quote approval: Clearview will designate a named approver (name and contact to be provided). Redwood will provide any proposed quote or press release draft at least 5 business days before publish for written approval; approval will not be unreasonably withheld.
• Logo usage: Redwood is granted a non-exclusive, revocable license to use Clearview’s name and logo on Redwood’s website (customer list) and in promotional materials. Redwood will not materially alter the logo assets; Redwood will cease use within 48 hours of a written takedown request.
• Co-branded releases: Redwood will provide a draft for review before publishing; both parties must provide written approval for co-branded press releases.

If that tracks for Clearview, we can update the Order Form with the exact clause and Ben can issue the signature-ready copy. If Clearview needs a named approver or tighter timing, happy to tweak.

Attachments: [Attachment: Proposed_Redlines_Clearview.docx (revised) (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
